lifetime.f4c958: Reads request[0] during the call and writes exactly twelve output bytes. Neither request nor a local result pointer escapes.
lifetime.f4ca60: Copies all request/state values into a single stack packet. f49598 must copy the complete packet synchronously. Callback words are values; their implementations belong to the calling machine owner.
lifetime.f4d2dc: Both temporary output halfwords remain alive through synchronous 74b05c.
lifetime.faf8a0: Temporary curve parameters and coefficient output bytes remain alive throughout synchronous numeric calls; weighted accumulation uses wrapping 64-bit sums and wrapping 32-bit sample products.

effects: Clipping rejection leaves the region unchanged and writes accepted=0; unset outputs are always all-ones.
Clipping acceptance updates the rectangle, both centre words and the halfword scale only.
Null-source rescaling clears six output words and does not clear the trailing record.
72872c increments the enabled trace count up to 0x1540 and writes operation, MMIO timer offset and tick register.
faf8a0 emits entry and exit trace operations around the sample calculation.
Immutable firmware lookup data remains data, not executable retained code.
